headline: High Swell & Squall Warning: Waves up to 2.8m expected near Ratnagiri
description: Squally weather with wind speeds reaching 40-50 km/h gusting to 55 km/h accompanied by high swell waves (2.2m to 2.8m) along South Maharashtra coast. Small craft and artisanal fishermen are advised not to venture into deep sea.
recommended_action: Avoid deep-water transit and small craft operations; exercise high vigilance in coastal approaches.

headline: Moderate Sea Advisory: Moderate swell and localized wind surges near Goa
description: Moderate sea conditions with wave heights between 1.5m and 2.1m and wind speeds 20-30 km/h. Sea operations manageable for mechanized fishing vessels with caution near river mouths.
recommended_action: Exercise caution near sandbars and estuary inlets during low tide.

headline: Port Navigation Caution: Elevated tidal currents in harbor approaches
description: Spring tide conditions generating enhanced cross-currents (up to 1.8 knots) in harbor navigation channels. Surface chop 1.2m to 1.6m.
recommended_action: Maintain tug assist for large vessels in inner navigation basins.

headline: Past Monsoon Depression Alert: Gale wind warning (Historical Archive)
description: Historical archived warning: Severe depression over central Arabian sea causing gale force winds 65 km/h. Complete suspension of fishing operations.

headline: Coastal Swell Advisory: Long period swell waves 1.6m near Karwar
description: Southwesterly swell with wave period 11-13 seconds observed along Karwar coast. Slight to moderate sea state.
recommended_action: Artisanal vessels monitor swell shoaling near coastal headlands.

headline: Deep Depression Warning: Rough to very rough seas off Gujarat coast
description: Squally winds 50-60 km/h gusting to 70 km/h over northeast Arabian Sea. Wave heights 3.5m to 4.2m. Total prohibition on fishing voyages.
recommended_action: Immediate return to harbor; hoist Local Cautionary Signal LC-III at all major ports.
